integrity: Analytic covariance identity and all-size sign proof; exact-rational enumeration through eight keys and recurrence checks through 120 keys; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniform insertion permutations and the successful search for the maximum key only. The covariance and correlation asymptotics do not establish full joint independence; historical priority has not been exhaustively verified.
title: Negative dependence between total path length and the extreme search path in random binary search trees
